title: WorkItem
description: Request body to create an inbound `workItem` task via a configured workItem channel. The `channel` must reference an active configured workItem channel in the organization. `workItemData` within `channelParams` carries the structured form payload — up to 50 entries, with keys up to 100 UTF-8 bytes and values up to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Origin of the task. For inbound `workItem` tasks, this represents the customer.

id.description: Customer's identifier, such as an email address.

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for the customer.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Destination for the workItem task. The `type` must be `businessAddress`.

id.description: Business address associated with the configured workItem channel entry point.

channelType.description: Discriminator field. Must be `workItem` for custom channel task creation.

channel.description: Identifier of the configured workItem channel in the organization. Required for `workItem` requests.
